$comment: Ground truth for the openai pack (docs/packs.md, "Ground truth"). Every public repository below merged an openai 4.x to 7.x upgrade and is pinned at the commit before it; found by mining npm manifests that moved openai from ^4 to ^7 and by searching for merged 4.104.0 to 7.x pull requests (RESEARCH.md lists the ones screened out). Expected findings were drafted by pnpm packs:truth and read by hand before the pack was scored: the diagnostics the repository's own TypeScript reports with the target (and the companions its upgrade moved, --also) linked in and not without them, and the lines the upgrade changed for openai (one site per change run, at its first line of code; comments, insertions and other packages' changes such as zod 4 and @openai/agents left out). A site no rule of the pack claims is `generic`. Each `with` lists what the upgrade moved because of openai (from its lockfile).
